empty.description: A goal says what this stretch of work delivers. Once it is set, the system keeps asking: did it ship, did anyone use it, are they still using it?
empty.footnote: One tier for now. When goals pile up across projects, you can add a tier to group them.

timeline.empty_description: Milestones appear here once a goal has one. Every goal gets a launch date first; adoption follows.
timeline.subtitle: Milestones laid out by product. What matters here is the distance between marks, not their length.
